integrity: All-parameter proof is supplied. Exact finite chain and embedding computations are reproducible; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Cyclic-order-preserving eight-vertex obstruction only. Does not settle the smaller remaining conjectured nonshellable range, homotopy type, Betti counts, or reorderings. Finite machine checks supplement an infinite proof.
title: A uniform nonshellability band for three-cut complexes of powered cycles
